# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_MORNING_KEYLEVEL_ARCHIVE

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** watcher_proposal  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Building a historical archive of key levels (prior day highs/lows, premarket highs/lows, multi-day trendlines, etc.) will enable the BEARISH_REJECTION_MORNING watcher to validate its signals on anchor days. Without this archive, we cannot assess whether the watcher would have captured the J winners (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) or avoided the losers (5/05, 5/06, 5/07). The archive allows offline validation and OOS backtesting by providing the structural context the watcher requires for level-rejection detection.

## Mechanism

A daily batch job will scan SPY 5-minute bars (RTH) and premarket data (where available) to identify: prior day high/low, premarket high/low, intra-day swing highs/lows, and multi-day trendlines (using 20-bar and 50-bar pivot highs/lows). Levels are stored in a date-keyed JSON archive with tolerance bands (±15 cents) to account for tick-size noise. The BEARISH_REJECTION_MORNING watcher will reference this archive during 09:35-10:55 ET to test for level rejections (close back below level after touch) when the EMA ribbon is bearish (Fast < Pivot < Slow). Archive updates occur post-market using only data available at that time to avoid look-ahead bias.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap.
2. **Sample bias:** Archive built from 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 (same as core engine backtest period). Selection: all trading days with available SPY 5-min and premarket data. Overfit risk: low (archive is structural, not optimized).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (archive construction is in-sample; OOS validation requires walk-forward on unseen dates post-archive build).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (archive uses mid-prices; real-fills validation requires OPRA bid/ask simulation on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/04 archive miss could turn +$730 winner into loss (current: -$23.95 on 4/29, -$21.56 on 5/01).
   - Max drawdown: current run shows $4,701.52 max drawdown (from Stage-1 result).
   - Blow-up scenario: archive includes invalid levels (e.g., from look-ahead bias) causing false signals on choppy days.
6. **Concentration:** Current run shows top5_pct=999.0 (indicating extreme concentration; likely due to few trades). Post-archive, concentration will be measured as % of P&L from top 5 days.

## Pre-merge gate

- Archive must pass structural validation (no look-ahead: all levels timestamped <= current bar).
- Gym validators for BEARISH_REJECTION_MORNING watcher must pass (78/78).
- Anchor-day validation: watcher must fire on 4/29 and 5/04 (J winners) with correct signal timing (10:25 ET and 10:27 ET respectively).
- OOS test: walk-forward on 2026-06-19 to 2026-09-07 must show positive edge_capture on J-like days (if any).
